recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7470 unless the work group opens a new broader TOC navigation redesign request.
issue_request: FHIR-7470 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request asking that the Full Table of Contents be more prominent and findable, with consideration for exposing section numbers in links. The recorded resolution was to make it more obvious by adding a link in the first paragraph, and a Jira comment says it was already added.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit f084e9118674e679a33c4223dd8288b33cd202d9, '#7470 - make ToC more obvious', which added 'don't miss the full Table of Contents' linking to toc.html in source/index.html on 2015-07-23.
additional_context: The current source/index.html still contains the same prominent Table of Contents link. source/hierarchy.xml registers toc.html under Home, and source/toc.html defines the current Table of Contents page with Summary and Detail tabs. A later homepage refactor in commit 4118eb9ddb6eabe52c56c903b3932f27c2c42e38 preserved the link. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence. FHIR-7785 is related ToC usability background but was not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current FHIR-core source already satisfies the final FHIR-7470 resolution, and adding more prose would be redundant rather than a necessary spec correction.

related_jiras.note: Separate Published/Persuasive 2015 Table of Contents usability issue applied by a neighboring source/toc.html commit; not decided because FHIR-7470 was already satisfied by the homepage link and FHIR-7785 would need its own audit scope.
